youtube.titulo: How a house key really works, seen from the future 🔑
youtube.descricao:
Kip, a relic hunter from the far future, digs up a jagged metal stick and has no idea what it did. So he travels back to the 2020s to find out how a key really opens a door: spring-loaded pins, the right cuts and one hidden line called the shear line.

What should Kip dig up next? Comment below.

The future world in this video is fiction. The lock explanation is based on how pin tumbler cylinder locks work (sources: Wikipedia "Pin tumbler lock", LockWiki, Science ABC, Designing Buildings Wiki).

tiktok.legenda: Nobody in the future knows what this jagged metal stick was for 🔑 Your house key is basically a password cut into metal. What should Kip dig up next?

reels.legenda: Your house key is a password cut into metal 🔑 Every tiny pin inside has to line up perfectly, or the door stays shut. Save this and send it to someone who has never thought about it.
